With advanced macular degeneration, a blind spot typically forms at the center of your visual field (shown right). Dry macular degeneration symptoms usually develop gradually and without pain. Dry macular degeneration usually affects both eyes. If only one eye is affected, you may not notice any changes in your vision because your good eye may compensate for the weak eye.
